title: russia says germanys closure its consulate bonn is absurd 2026 09 03
text:
MOSCOW, Sept 3 (Reuters) - The Kremlin said on ​Thursday that Germany ‌was displaying an inconsistent and absurd position ​by choosing to ​shutter the Russian consulate ⁠in Bonn, ​a decision Berlin took ​after a drone incident at the Leipzig/Halle Airport.
Germany's ​response measures ​included the closure of a ‌Russian ⁠cultural centre in Berlin and the consulate in Bonn. ​On ​Tuesday, ⁠President Vladimir Putin accused Germany ​of planting evidence ​in ⁠order to blame Moscow for the ⁠incident.
